my_t_value <- function(x, comparison_value) {
  mean_x <- my_mean(x)
  se_x <- my_se(x)

  output <- (mean_x - comparison_value) / se_x
  return(output)
}

my_t_value(scores, comparison_value = 50)
#> [1] 1.414214
t.test(scores, mu = comparison_value)

heading: 5.3 Covariance

products <- dx * dy

my_covariance <- function(x, y) {
  dx <- x - my_mean(x)
  dy <- y - my_mean(y)
  products <- dx * dy
  output <- sum(products) / (length(x) - 1)
  return(output)
}

my_covariance(x, y)
#> [1] 18.85714
cov(x, y)
#> [1] 18.85714
my_covariance(x, x)
#> [1] 6
my_var(x)
#> [1] 6

code:

#> [1] 18.85714
my_covariance(x * 60, y)
#> [1] 1131.429
my_correlation <- function(x, y) {
  covariance <- my_covariance(x, y)
  sd_x <- my_sd(x)
  sd_y <- my_sd(y)
  output <- covariance / (sd_x * sd_y)
  return(output)
}

my_correlation(x, y)
#> [1] 0.9072647
cor(x, y)
#> [1] 0.9072647
my_correlation(x * 60, y)
#> [1] 0.9072647

my_correlation_t <- function(x, y) {
  r <- my_correlation(x, y)
  n <- length(x)
  output <- r * sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r^2))
  return(output)
}

my_correlation_t(x, y)
#> [1] 5.284229
cor.test(x, y, method = "pearson")

#>  Pearson's product-moment correlation
